# third_party

Local binaries fetched by setup scripts. Not committed.

```bash
python scripts/setup_fluidsynth.py
python scripts/setup_fluidsynth.py --status
python scripts/setup_edit_fonts.py
python scripts/setup_edit_fonts.py --status
```

- `fluidsynth/` — FluidSynth Windows x64 (MIDI → WAV)
- `soundfonts/GeneralUser-GS.sf2` — GM piano / band bank
- `fonts/` — OFL Hangul display (Black Han Sans, Jua, Do Hyeon) for `--font yeonung|hook|soft`
